instructions: Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: Four fifths of the trees the volunteers stood among were Norway spruce, the remaining fifth being ........ .
items.evidence: In the forest condition, participants walked for five minutes to reach a stand of Norway spruce and silver birch trees, roughly 80 and 20 per cent of the stand respectively, ranging in age from 80 to 108 years and fully covered in snow, where they spent 15 minutes simply standing or sitting quietly.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the stand is roughly 80 per cent spruce and 20 per cent birch; since the question asks for the species making up the remaining fifth, the answer is 'silver birch'.

items.prompt: The air on the days of the outdoor sessions was almost windless and extremely damp, with ........ measured at 94.25 per cent.
items.evidence: The forest sessions took place in late January, in conditions typical of a Finnish winter: an average temperature of minus 7.23 degrees Celsius, 20 to 25 centimetres of snow covering the ground and trees, humidity of 94.25 per cent, and only a light wind of 1.13 metres per second.
items.explanation: Paragraph D, listing the conditions during the forest sessions, gives the humidity as 94.25 per cent; since the question asks for the quantity measured at 94.25 per cent, the answer is 'humidity'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'extremely damp, with ___ measured at 94.25%' kalibinda; 'damp' (nemli) sifatiyla dogal olarak eslesen olculebilir nicelik 'humidity' (nem orani) oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: Bosluk yuzde olarak verilen bir hava olcumunu istiyor; pasajin siraladigi dort degerden (sicaklik, kar derinligi, nem, ruzgar) yalniz biri yuzdeyle ifade edilir, dolayisiyla sayinin birimi tek basina cevabi veriyor. Birimi gizlemek sayiyi da gizlemeyi gerektiriyor, o zaman da soru olculebilir bir ayrintiya dayanmaktan cikiyor. E6 bu yuvayi ruzgar hizina (1.13 m/s) ya da kar derinligine capalamali.

items.prompt: All four scales were filled in on paper right before and right after the quarter of an hour, making it possible to credit any shift to the setting itself rather than to the mere ........ of time.
items.evidence: All four instruments were administered as paper questionnaires immediately before and again immediately after each 15-minute period, so that any change could be attributed specifically to the intervening exposure rather than to the simple passage of time.
items.explanation: Paragraph E explains that the scales were filled in immediately before and after the 15 minutes so that any change could be attributed to the setting rather than to the 'mere passage of time'; so the answer is 'passage'.
items.flag_reason: Bosluk 'the mere ___ of time' kalibinin ucunda; 'the passage of time' Ingilizcede tamamen kaliplasmis bir ifade oldugu icin parcaya bakmadan da tahmin edilebiliyor.
items.reject_reason: 'the passage of time' Ingilizcede tam kaliplasmis bir ifade; bosluk bu kalibin icinde durdugu surece hangi cerceveye konursa konsun tek tamamlamasi var, 'of time' kaldirildiginda ise cumle anlamini yitiriyor. E6 bu yuvayi ayni cumlenin olculebilir ayrintisina (anketlerin kagit uzerinde, on bes dakikanin hemen oncesinde ve hemen sonrasinda uygulanmasi) tasimali.

items.prompt: One explanation put forward for the absence of any rise in vigour is that a thick white layer conceals the green ........ which earlier work has tied to sharper alertness.
items.evidence: The researchers suggest that snow itself may partly explain why vigour failed to rise after the forest visit, since a thick covering of snow hides the green vegetation that other studies have linked to increased energy and alertness, leaving only the calming, restorative effect intact rather than the more energising one.
items.explanation: Paragraph H explains the lack of increase in vigour by the fact that snow covers the green vegetation that other studies have linked to energy and alertness; so the answer is 'vegetation'.
items.flag_reason: Parça gösterilmeden anlamca 3/3 turda doğru bilindi: farklı kelimeyle ama doğru kavramla cevaplandı ('vegetation / foliage / vegetation' verdi, 'foliage' aynı göndergeyi karşılıyor).
items.reject_reason: Model parcasiz uc turun ikisinde birebir 'vegetation', birinde tam es anlamlisi 'foliage' verdi -- yani sizinti kelime duzeyinde bile neredeyse tam. Boslugun hedefi 'karin ortudugu yesillik' ve bunun Ingilizcede birden cok es adi var (vegetation / greenery / foliage / plant life). Kanit cumlesi (H/1) canliligin neden yukselmedigini yalniz bu tek nedenle acikliyor, dolayisiyla her cerceve 'kalin kar neyi gizler' sorusuna donuyor ve cevabi kendisi veriyor. E6 onerisi: ayni cumlenin son yarisi -- yalniz sakinlestirici etkinin ayakta kalmasi, canlandirici etkinin kalmamasi -- ya da H/2'deki orneklem sinirlari (tek kurum, kucuk orneklem, onerilen uc genisletme).
